June 22 (Monday) is the week's binary event: gate-clear = add NVDA at $205–$215; gate-miss = hold and wait for Annual Meeting June 24.

dont_buy.ticker: Any new equity long before June 22 open confirmation
dont_buy.reason: US equity markets are closed Saturday and Sunday. DXY is improving but has NOT confirmed below 100 yet — it needs a Monday June 22 session close to confirm the gate. The institutional community is dark on weekends; weekend FX moves can and often do reverse in the first 30 minutes of Monday Asian session. The conditional-add framework exists precisely to prevent adding on pre-market optimism that unwinds.
dont_buy.better_entry: June 22 regular session — confirm DXY closes below 100 AND VIX stays below 17 on the same session before executing any conditional add. Annual Meeting June 24 is the secondary entry window regardless of gate status.

bear_case: The weekend improvement is real but unconfirmed: DXY at 100.23 is still above 100 (the gate requires a Monday June 22 session CLOSE below 100, not a weekend FX print), and the IBIT inflow story may be partially from an earlier streak resolution (May-June 3) rather than a confirmed post-FOMC reversal. Warsh's 'no forward guidance' posture means any Fed speaker between June 22-26 can re-accelerate hawkish repricing: if a scheduled June 22 Fed speech uses the macro improvement as justification for maintaining the rate-hike probability at 3.8% median, DXY could reverse the weekend decline within hours. The 30Y at 4.93% remains 7 basis points from the 5.00% critical gate — a continued 30Y approach to 5.00% simultaneously compresses NVDA's multiple, extends SPCX's correction, and keeps BTC's macro headwind intact. Post-FOMC Week 2 (June 22-26) is historically the weakest 5 days in the risk-recovery cycle (8-of-9 pattern). The Annual Meeting June 24 is a two-way catalyst — any Jensen disappointment resets expectations downward and could extend the correction.
